title: DOC: add is_flash_key invariant block comment at wp11_key_obj_t definition
description: The is_flash_key flag on wp11_key_obj_t (src/wp11_pkcs11.c) distinguishes two incompatible ownership semantics for key_priv: (0) heap-alloc'd wp11_soft_key_t owned by g_keys, freed by wp11_soft_key_free; (1) pointer into keystore entries array owned by wp11_keystore_t, must NOT be freed. The C_DestroyObject bug (wolfP11-at1) happened because this invariant was not applied consistently. The existing per-function comment was insufficient. Fix: add a block comment at the struct field definition listing EVERY call site that must check is_flash_key before touching key_priv (C_Finalize, C_DestroyObject, and any future function). This is the canonical documentation that prevents the bug from recurring.
